paras: Application: Toyota GR86 and Subaru BRZ (2022+) Part Type: PCV Fluid Lock oil catch can kit Part Number: 20-0911-FL

The Radium 20-0911-FL catch can kit runs inline with the 5/8in PCV valve hose and mounts on the RH side of the engine bay of the 2022+ GR86 and BRZ. It separates oil and water condensation from crankcase gases before they reach the intake, keeping the intake, throttle body and manifold cleaner and keeping oil vapour out of the cabin.
hl: PCV Circuit: Inline with the 5/8in PCV valve hose, RH side of the engine bay
Fluid Lock: Patented Fluid Lock design stops the reservoir overfilling and traps collected fluid until the can is emptied
Large Ports: 10AN ORB inlet and outlet ports
Dipstick: O-ring sealed dipstick to check the fluid level
ft: Radium Engineering Fluid Lock PCV Catch Can Kit for Subaru BRZ ZD8/Toyota GR86 2022+
